subject: Coloring single tip node based on label

messages.author: ac308c86ddac0ae5
messages.subject: Coloring single tip node based on label
parts:
I don't actually need anything, but I thought I'd leave this here for the next person.

I wanted to adjust the color of a single node on my tree based on its label. I didn't need anything fancy, so my google search wasn't helpful.

The following changes the node of "interesting_sample" red.

```
tree <- read.newick("iqtree.treefile")

ggtree(tree)  + geom_tippoint(aes(subset=(label==interesting_sample)), color = "red") 
```
